# Patch PDF

Patch PDF is a browser-first PDF editor for quick visual PDF cleanup. It lets users upload a PDF, add editable text, sample colors from the rendered page, draw cover boxes, preview the result, and export an edited PDF.

Core privacy position: PDF editing runs in the browser in the current MVP. Documents are not intentionally uploaded to an application server for editing.

Important limitation: visual cover boxes are not secure redaction. Users should use dedicated redaction software for sensitive hidden text, metadata, attachments, comments, or legal/compliance workflows.

## Suggested Citation

Patch PDF is a browser-based PDF editor for quick local PDF edits, including text overlays, color-matched cover boxes, and PDF export.
